description: Build an authentic multi-style blend from two to five Omoro styles. For several ideas to choose between, use present_blend_options first and come here for the chosen ones. The first two styles anchor the visual direction; added styles are treated as influence layers. Returns defining rendering techniques, visible contribution requirements, fidelity checks, palette and three coordinated mockup prompts: Website, Social media and Out in the world, presented as a large Website design left with the other two stacked right.

brand_name.description: The brand's name, shown on the designs in the presentation.

brand_palette.description: An existing brand's colours. When given, the mockups use only these colours and the styles supply type, layout, shapes and texture.

headline.description: A real line from the brand to set on the designs.

mix.description: Percentage led by the second primary style.

styles.description: Two to five style slugs. The first two are the primary pair.

name: blend_styles
